Are there parameters left to condition a plot or table on?

Source: R/plots_utils.R
has_other_parameters.Rd

The metric-versus-parameters plots and tables loop over one of a method's parameters at a time and condition on the rest, taken as parameters[, -i]. Whether any rest remain is not the same question as whether that frame has rows. A method carrying a single parameter - separate and pooling carry only initial_prior - loses its only column, and a data frame with no columns keeps every one of its rows, so nrow() still reports something to loop over. The loop then asks for a label for a row that holds nothing, which fails with invalid subscript type 'list'.

A remainder that has collapsed to a bare vector also counts as nothing, which is what these call sites have always done.

Usage

has_other_parameters(other_parameters)

Arguments

other_parameters

The remaining parameters, as returned by parameters[, -i].

Value

TRUE when there is at least one parameter left to condition on.
